summary: Two alert dialogs, a plain sign out confirmation and a destructive project delete, with an event log below.
use: Asking the user to confirm an interrupting action such as signing out or deleting a project.
spec: Sign out dialog: `bind:open={signOutOpen}`, `confirmLabel="Sign out"`, `onconfirm` and `oncancel` handlers
Triggers are `<Button variant="outlined"` and `<Button variant="destructive"` with `{#snippet leading()}` icons `<LogOut size={14} />` and `<Trash2 size={14} />`
Handlers call `push('Signed out')`, `push('Sign out cancelled')` and `push('Project deleted')`
Log keeps the latest four entries with `slice(0, 4)` in a `<ul class="log" aria-live="polite">`
